description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant on Number 2 Road in Richmond, BC, offering burgers, chicken sandwiches, McCafé beverages, and a full breakfast menu. The location has a drive-through and is part of the MyMcDonald's Rewards app program. As a well-known chain stop, it is a predictable resupply point for touring cyclists passing through the Richmond area.
